apiContract.D_retry: per-request: on 429/5xx/network error -> exponential backoff (30s, 60s, 120s, 300s), max 5 attempts, then abort the build attempt (never skip an anchor)
apiContract.E_rateLimiting: client-side throttle: sequential dispatch with >= 1s spacing per endpoint; documented technical limits respected (<= 20 parameters per point request); official quota UNVERIFIED (429 exists) -> conservative throttling mandatory
apiContract.F_cache: raw responses persisted under pilot/raw/nasa/<batch>/ with per-request metadata sidecar (request URL, parameters, timestamp, byte size, sha256); cache hit = identical parameter set + recorded sha256 verified
apiContract.G_duplicateAvoidance: manifest-driven: a request is issued only if no sidecar with identical normalized parameter set exists; parameter set is canonicalized (sorted key=value) before comparison
apiContract.H_requestLogging: every request logs: endpoint, full query parameters, community, time-standard, start/end, retrieval timestamp, destinationId, pilot/gate version
apiContract.I_responseHash: sha256 recorded per raw response at acquisition time and re-verified before any normalization run
apiContract.J_deterministicBuild: normalization/aggregation operate exclusively on hash-verified cached raw responses; no network in the normalize phase; outputs sorted with sort_keys; double rebuild byte-identical (freeze determinism PASS)
apiContract.K_apiFailure: acquisition failure -> build FAIL/BLOCKED; previous validated canonical retained; no partial canonical generation; no deployment
apiContract.L_staleCanonicalFallback: allowed ONLY as retain-previous-validated-artifact on build failure (version-locked whole-dataset switch). Never a partial/mixed-source dataset; never a runtime fallback
